parsed.rationale: This is RBBB, not 1st degree AV block: V1 and V2 show an rsR' (M-shaped) QRS that is wide (≥120 ms), with broad slurred S waves in I, aVL, V5 and V6, while the PR interval is about 140 ms and therefore normal (1st degree AV block would need a PR over 200 ms); the ST-T changes in V1–V3 are the expected secondary changes of RBBB, with no ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
